name: hwahap
description: Plan, build, and review repository changes through a local MCP runtime.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, build, and review changes with Codex.
interface.longDescription: A local workflow for confirmed plans, tested changes, and independent draft reviews. Selects model and effort from a replaceable capability catalog and current Codex host availability. Requires Git and authenticated GitHub CLI.
defaultPrompt: Use Hwahap to plan this change.
Use Hwahap to implement and review this change.
